Quick Chewy Cookies
By: Leta
Published: Wednesday, June 2, 2010 - 9:54pm

Ingredients




1 package Brownie mix/with choc chips or nuts
1 large egg
 cup oil
2 teaspoons water
Preheat oven 375

Preparation

1 Mix Brownie mix with oil, egg, & water, until it's mixed well.. and forms a soft dough.. 2 On greased cookie sheet drop by spoon fulls..Bake about 6-8 minutes.. Don't over bake... Center should be soft,,, Let cool, these are good right out of the oven, but, can be iced... makes about 2 doz
